item.title: Rwanda Secures $78.5 Million IFAD Funding to Modernize Agriculture
item.description: IFAD approved $78.5 million to support Rwanda’s agricultural transformation and climate resilience. item.title: Togo Updates Aquaculture Legal Framework to Support Sector Growth
item.description: Togo initiated a revision of its aquaculture legal framework to align with production, investment, and biosafety needs. National production reached about 3,500 tonnes, up from roughly 120 tonnes in the 2010s. item.title: Kenya Plans $350 Million Investment to Restore Lake Victoria Basin
item.description: Kenya plans to invest about $350 million over ten years to restore ecosystems and livelihoods in the Lake Victoria basin. item.title: Rwanda Signs $150 Million Poverty Reduction Partnership With GiveDirectly
item.description: Rwanda and GiveDirectly will mobilize more than $150 million over five years to reduce poverty by 25% in the five poorest districts. item.title: Zimbabwe Halts Lithium Concentrate Exports in Push for Value Addition
item.description: Zimbabwe imposed an immediate ban on lithium concentrate exports, advancing a planned 2027 deadline by one year. Authorities applied the embargo to shipments already in transit and did not specify its duration. item.title: Sub-Saharan Africa Defense Spending Jumps 19% to $23.6 Billion in 2025, IISS Says
item.description: Sub-Saharan Africa raised defense spending by 19% in 2025 to $23.6 billion, according to IISS. Nigeria nearly doubled its defense budget to $2.29 billion, while South Africa cut spending by 2.5%. Global defense spending rose 2.5% to $2.63 trillion, with Europe posting a 12.6% increase.
